name: LIFE Privacy Evaluation — held-out linkability metrics

inputs.truth: oracle-only truth TSV; must never be passed to attack scoring code
inputs.scores: attack output with pair_id and score only
inputs.training_subjects: subject IDs available during attacker training/tuning; must be disjoint from test subjects

bootstrap.method: subject-cluster resampling with pair multiplicity weights
bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% interval; not a formal privacy guarantee

pilot_minimums.interpretation: necessary sample-size gates, not sufficient evidence or an automatic pass

source_contracts: scores TSV cannot contain labels or subject IDs
subject overlap between train and test fails closed
pair IDs are opaque and unique
comparison_policy: Run all required observer/scenario pairs where applicable; separately report each attacker and the strongest attacker result. Never treat an inapplicable channel as a privacy pass.

paired_comparison.pairing: exact pair IDs, subjects, labels and strata must match; both score files join independently against oracle truth
paired_comparison.uncertainty: paired subject-cluster bootstrap; same subject multiplicities applied to baseline and treatment; percentile 95% interval for treatment-minus-baseline ROC-AUC
paired_comparison.claim_ceiling: a supported paired AUC reduction is not an unlinkability pass; smoke-size inputs cannot qualify a profile; utility and official conformance are not evaluated

low_fpr_reporting_policy.old_command: TPR at empirical FPR caps is an exploratory test-curve statistic; no validation-locked threshold
low_fpr_reporting_policy.calibrated_command: Select threshold using validation labels only; enforce disjoint calibration/test subjects and pair handles; report fixed-threshold test TPR/FPR
low_fpr_reporting_policy.zero_false_positive_policy: zero observed false positives do not qualify rare-event risk; report inconclusive unless a separately justified tail-risk method is provided

schema_change_note: Added explicit fields declaring empirical low-FPR test-curve values are descriptive, not validation-locked operating points.
coverage_contract_change_note: W3C credential threat-to-evidence mapping is design coverage only; it does not imply implementation, mitigation, conformance, or release qualification.

retrieval_evaluation.truth_schema: query_id, query_subject, candidate_id, candidate_subject, true_match, stratum; oracle-only and never passed to attack scoring
retrieval_evaluation.score_schema: query_id, candidate_id, score only; opaque handles and finite score
retrieval_evaluation.cohort_policy: Every query has exactly one true candidate and exactly the same candidate-handle/subject pool; query subject must be present in the candidate pool
leakage_guards: training identities disjoint from all query and candidate subjects
exact truth/score pair join; no missing or extra scores
retrieval_evaluation.tie_policy: Uniform expected rank over the true candidate's tied score block; fractional Top-k credit and expected reciprocal rank prevent identifier-order tie breaks
retrieval_evaluation.uncertainty: Query-subject cluster bootstrap conditioned on a fixed candidate pool; it does not account for candidate-pool sampling uncertainty

sample_minimums.interpretation: screening floor only; never an automatic privacy pass

retrieval_evaluation.claim_ceiling: Ranked retrieval risk only. Scores are not calibrated posterior probabilities; no effective anonymity set is inferred. Task utility and official conformance are separate gates.

retrieval_fixture_note: Four-query synthetic known-answer fixture validates ranking and tie semantics only; no real-credential or SOTA claim.

definitions.mated_query: Exactly one true candidate exists in the candidate pool.
definitions.nonmated_query: The query subject is absent from the candidate pool and no candidate row is a true match.
definitions.FPIR: Fraction of non-mated query subjects for which any candidate score is at least the locked threshold.
definitions.FNIR_at_rank_k: Fraction of mated queries whose true candidate is not accepted at the locked threshold within top K; tied target rank receives fractional credit.

open_set_evaluation.threshold_selection: Validation-only: maximize rank-1 correct identification rate while empirical validation FPIR remains at or below the declared cap; tie-breaking prefers lower observed FPIR. Freeze before test.
split_policy: Validation/test query IDs and query subject identities are disjoint
Training subjects are disjoint from all query and candidate subjects
Validation/test candidate handles and subject mappings must match exactly
Each partition contains mated and non-mated queries; each query has zero or one true match
open_set_evaluation.uncertainty: Class-stratified query-subject cluster bootstrap for FNIR@rank1, FNIR@rank5 and FPIR; conditional on a fixed candidate pool

pilot_minimums.interpretation: screening floor per class, not a confidence guarantee or automatic pass; distinct identities, not repeated sessions, must satisfy subject counts

open_set_evaluation.zero_false_identification_policy: A zero event count is not a pass by itself. Report the one-sided 95% subject-cluster Hoeffding upper bound; at a 1% target, zero observed events need 14,979 independent non-mated subject clusters before this conservative bound can be at or below target.
open_set_evaluation.claim_ceiling: Open-set identification metrics only. Ranking scores are not posterior probabilities; the mode does not claim an effective anonymity set, task utility, official protocol conformance, or a formal privacy guarantee.

subject_level_risk_bound.unit: one non-mated query-subject cluster; event=any query from that subject has any candidate score at or above the validation-locked threshold
subject_level_risk_bound.operating_gate: the independent test upper bound must not exceed max_fpir_target and the query-level FPIR bootstrap upper interval must also not exceed the same target; passing remains provisional and does not imply privacy, utility or conformance
assumptions_and_limits: subject clusters are treated as independent draws conditional on the frozen scorer and fixed candidate gallery
conditional on the fixed gallery; does not cover gallery-population uncertainty, distribution shift, or dependent subjects
conservative distribution-free bound; not a differential-privacy or formal unlinkability guarantee

open_set_fixture_note: Four-query-per-partition synthetic control tests validation locking, mated/non-mated separation, candidate-pool consistency, per-subject session aggregation and risk-bound semantics only; no real-credential result is implied.
